about: Project-scoped requests (Release 1 plan, M00 baseline). Invented projects and people. Each project has a Focus with an objective and two pinned notes, and five notes filed with it; the Brain also holds Brain-wide notes. Requests name a project (or, for `implicit`, only its subject). Measured: the needed note reached, the pins delivered for a status request, and notes from other projects leaking in. `conflicts` are two live values for one fact on the same date, which should both be shown, and `updates` a newer dated value, which should be current with the older one marked.
